Miner trader

A resource trading point with a safe zone and recycler.

What to do

You can trade stone with the trader here. Check the trade menu for the items and amount of stone required. There is another Stonecutter near the meteorite drill.

Main rewards

Trade gathered materials or recycle suitable items nearby.

Risks

Watch the safe-zone indicator; PvP danger returns beyond its boundary.

Recycler

There is a recycler here. It breaks down recyclable items and makes noise while running.
